item.title: El trigo europeo sube tras visita de enviados de EEUU que ofrece pocas esperanzas en Ucrania
item.description: El precio del trigo europeo subió el lunes impulsado por los escasos indicios de avance en la iniciativa diplomática de Estados Unidos para poner fin a la guerra en Ucrania —que ha perturbado los envíos desde la región del mar Negro— y por la fuerte demanda de trigo en la Unión Europea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El precio del trigo europeo subió el lunes impulsado por los escasos indicios de avance en la iniciativa diplomática de Estados Unidos para poner fin a la guerra en Ucrania —que ha perturbado los envíos desde la región del mar Negro— y por la fuerte demanda de trigo en la Unión Europea. El trigo panificable de referencia para diciembre en la Euronext de París cerró la sesión diurna con un alza del 1,2%, en 249,25 euros por tonelada métrica. La cotización seguía siendo menor del máximo del contrato, de 256,75 euros por tonelada, alcanzado la semana pasada. Los mercados de Chicago permanecieron cerrados con motivo del Día del Trabajo en Estados Unidos. Los enviados de paz estadounidenses Jared Kushner y Steve Witkoff se reunieron con el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, en Moscú, y con el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, en Kiev durante el fin de semana, pero sus esfuerzos diplomáticos no parecieron lograr un avance decisivo para poner fin a la guerra. "La visita de los enviados estadounidenses a Rusia no parece haber dado lugar a un avance en el proceso de paz que permita reanudar las exportaciones marítimas de cereales de Ucrania y Rusia", señaló un operador alemán. Los ataques recíprocos de Rusia y Ucrania contra los puertos y la flota mercante del otro han paralizado casi por completo las exportaciones de ambos países desde el mar Negro, lo que ha obligado a los compradores a buscar alternativas. "Los países occidentales de la UE, incluida Francia, han conseguido nuevas ventas a Egipto, Sudán y África Occidental para sustituir los envíos del mar Negro, lo que está respaldando los precios", señaló un comerciante.

item.title: Springboks make two changes to starting XV for final New Zealand test
item.description: South Africa have made two changes to their starting XV for the fourth and final test against New Zealand in Baltimore, United States, on Saturday as they look to claim the self-styled Rugby's Greatest Rivalry series against their old foes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Africa have made two changes to their starting XV for the fourth and final test against New Zealand in Baltimore, United States, on Saturday as they look to claim the self-styled Rugby's Greatest Rivalry series against their old foes. The Springboks lead 2-1 after the first three tests and coach Rassie Erasmus has largely stuck to his tried and trusted again for the final fixture. Damian Willemse returns from injury to take over from Cheslin Kolbe at fullback after the latter fractured his jaw in last Saturday's [USN:L6N44X05T TEXT:"29-24 victory"] in Soweto. Morne van den Berg is elevated from the bench to start at scrumhalf, with Cobus Reinach taking his place among the replacements. Erasmus has otherwise stuck with the same match-day 23 that did duty in the last test. Lock Eben Etzebeth will extend his record as the most capped Springbok player of all time to 146 caps. The Springboks have won seven of the last nine matches against the All Blacks dating back to August 2023. "We feel that the team is well settled and all the players delivered in their respective roles in the last two matches, so we believe selecting the same matchday squad, and naming Damian back in his regular position, makes sense for the closing match of the series," said Erasmus. South Africa team: 15-Damian Willemse, 14-Kurt-Lee Arendse, 13-Jesse Kriel, 12-Damian de Allende, 11-Ethan Hooker, 10-Sacha Feinberg-Mngomezulu, 9-Morne van den Berg, 8-Jasper Wiese, 7-Pieter-Steph du Toit, 6-Siya Kolisi (captain), 5-Ruan Nortje, 4-Eben Etzebeth, 3-Wilco Louw, 2-Malcolm Marx, 1-Ox Nche Replacements: 16-Deon Fourie, 17-Gerhard Steenekamp, 18-Thomas du Toit, 19-Lood de Jager, 20-Andre Esterhuizen, 21-Cameron Hanekom, 22-Cobus Reinach, 23-Manie Libbok.

item.title: Itália registra verão mais quente em mais de 75 anos, afirma instituto
item.description: A Itália registrou este ano o verão mais quente desde 1950, com uma temperatura média de 24,3 graus Celsius, informou nesta segunda-feira o Instituto de Bioeconomia do Conselho Nacional de Pesquisa (CNR-IBE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Itália registrou este ano o verão mais quente desde 1950, com uma temperatura média de 24,3 graus Celsius, informou nesta segunda-feira o Instituto de Bioeconomia do Conselho Nacional de Pesquisa (CNR-IBE). Agosto foi o mês mais quente do ano, com uma temperatura média de 25,6°C, 5,2°C acima da média do período de 1951 a 1980 e 3,5°C acima da média do período de 1991 a 2020, segundo o órgão público. Os dados se baseiam em medições realizadas a dois metros acima do nível do solo. “A média de 25,6 graus Celsius registrada em agosto de 2026 supera os recordes anteriores de 24,6°C em 2024 e 24,0°C atingidos em agosto de 2017”, disse Lorenzo Arcidiaco, pesquisador do CNR-IBE. Arcidiaco disse que os dados indicam que 2026 terminará como o ano mais quente da Itália desde que os dados com os quais ele trabalha começaram a ser coletados, em 1950, com julho e agosto classificados como os meses mais quentes já registrados. O CNR é a maior instituição pública de pesquisa da Itália. Grande parte da Europa, o continente que mais rapidamente se aquece no mundo, passou por verões escaldantes, com a seca e os incêndios florestais se tornando um problema cada vez maior. O Reino Unido teve seu verão mais quente desde o início dos registros. As áreas da Itália mais afetadas concentraram-se nas planícies do noroeste e ao longo dos Apeninos, muitas delas regiões agrícolas onde as temperaturas mais altas e as condições de seca têm pressionado a atividade agrícola. Análises separadas de dados meteorológicos mostraram que grandes cidades como Roma, Florença e Turim foram todas atingidas por repetidas ondas de calor em junho, julho e agosto. (Reportagem de Keith Weir)

item.title: Rockies activate 3B Kyle Karros after 2nd concussion IL stint
item.description: The Colorado Rockies activated third baseman Kyle Karros from his second stint on the 10-day concussion injured list on Monday, ahead of Tuesday's road series opener at the New York Yankees.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Colorado Rockies activated third baseman Kyle Karros from his second stint on the 10-day concussion injured list on Monday, ahead of Tuesday's road series opener at the New York Yankees. Karros originally sustained the concussion Aug. 11 in a collision with shortstop Ezequiel Tovar against the Arizona Diamondbacks. He originally returned Aug. 21, but he played just two games before he was placed back on the concussion IL with "symptoms similar to his concussion," manager Warren Schaeffer told reporters. The 24-year-old cleared protocols for the second time last week and was 6-for-15 with a home run in four appearances for Double-A Hartford. In a corresponding move, the Rockies optioned infielder/outfielder Ryan Ritter to Triple-A Albuquerque. The concussion interrupted a promising first full season in the majors for Karros, the son of longtime major leaguer Eric Karros. He's hitting .263 with a .360 on-base percentage, 10 homers and 44 RBIs in 114 games for Colorado. Karros debuted last August and has a career .253 average with 11 homers and 53 RBIs in 157 games for the Rockies. Ritter, 25, hit .158 with one RBI in 16 major league games this season. He has a career .233 average with one homer and 19 RBIs over 76 games the last two seasons for Colorado. --Field Level Media

item.title: Zheng mounts another fight back to stun Swiatek in fourth round
item.description: Chinese qualifier Zheng Qinwen produced another spectacular fight back to upset six-times major winner Iga Swiatek 7-5 6-3 in the U.S. Open on Monday, recovering from 0-5 down in the opening set to reach the quarter-finals.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Chinese qualifier Zheng Qinwen produced another spectacular fight back to upset six-times major winner Iga Swiatek 7-5 6-3 in the U.S. Open on Monday, recovering from 0-5 down in the opening set to reach the quarter-finals. The Olympic champion battled her way through qualifiers amid a career slump and has recaptured her top form in New York, getting the best of an opponent who had led 7-to-1 in their head-to-head before Monday. "I start the match really slow. That's why she's able to lead 5-0. After that, I start to play more freely, let's say, because I think I need to try to find my rhythm at least for the second set," said Zheng, whose chronic right elbow injury stunted her career and forced her to undergo surgery last year. "Somehow, I felt really comfortable on court, and in one moment I also lose (track of) the score, because I'm so focused to playing every single point. I think that's the key for me to come back. I didn't expect that today, but somehow it's just happening again." She next plays second seed Elena Rybakina of Kazakhstan. Zheng appears to do her best work with her back against the wall, recovering from five games to love in the deciding set of her [USN:L6N44X041 TEXT:"third round match"] this week, and she found the magic again at Arthur Ashe Stadium, saving three set points to the increasing frustration of the 2022 champion Swiatek. Swiatek took a medical timeout after the third game of the second set, having a physio come and massage her left thigh, but did not appear to struggle as she returned to the court. Zheng broke her opponent with a backhand winner down the line in the seventh game and broke again on the fourth match point, leaving Swiatek in [USN:L8N3JO2HF TEXT:"tears again"] two years after she stunningly beat the Pole in the Olympic semi-finals. "It's tough to get over that when it happens. And maybe I could have played more safe or something, but I also didn't feel like I had space with Qinwen to do that," said Swiatek. "If I would be more solid than her, I would win this game, but I wasn't solid and I was missing too much."

item.title: Former F1 supremo Ecclestone stopped in Portugal over shotgun on private jet
item.description: Ex-Formula One supremo Bernie Ecclestone was stopped at an airport in Portugal on Monday after police found he had brought a shotgun into the country on his private jet without documentation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ex-Formula One supremo Bernie Ecclestone was stopped at an airport in Portugal on Monday after police found he had brought a shotgun into the country on his private jet without documentation. The 95-year-old told Reuters in a telephone call from Portugal that he was carrying the gun with him from Switzerland for a clay pigeon shooting event but lacked a necessary 'blue book' to import it. Ecclestone said he had landed with his wife Fabiana, who is a vice-president for sport at Formula One's governing body, at Tires airfield near the resort town of Cascais outside Lisbon. "All that happened is that I took a gun that I've been using in Switzerland for clay pigeon shooting into the country to do some clay pigeon shooting in Portugal at a place where they had this weekend an exhibition thing going on," he explained. Ecclestone, who does not speak Portuguese, said he had passed customs but then the police asked about the gun and sought documentation, leading to what he called "unnecessary aggravation". His Brazilian-born wife eventually went to Lisbon, accompanied by a customs official, to surrender the gun to the authorities. "So now we've gone through all this and the people in Lisbon have got the gun," he said. "I've signed some documents as they wanted." Portuguese newspapers first reported the incident, quoting police sources saying authorities discovered the shotgun during a routine check. Ecclestone, a former racer who ran the commercial side of the sport for some 40 years until being ousted in 2017, owns a home in the adjoining resort area. The episode echoed the Briton's [USN:L3N2XJ1DW TEXT:"earlier brush with the law"] over an unregistered weapon in Brazil, where he was briefly detained in 2022 for carrying a small handgun while boarding a private plane to Switzerland. Ecclestone then acknowledged owning the gun, but said he was unaware it was in his luggage, dismissing the incident as "silly" and "tiny".

item.title: Paris investigates claim women were hidden from Hindu delegation at Eiffel Tower
item.description: Female employees at the Eiffel Tower were asked to step out of sight during a visit by a Hindu religious delegation at the weekend, according to union representatives, prompting a staff protest and an investigation by Paris city authorities.
item.dc:creator: Lewis Macdonald, Clotaire Achi
item.content:encoded: Female employees at the Eiffel Tower were asked to step out of sight during a visit by a Hindu religious delegation at the weekend, according to union representatives, prompting a staff protest and an investigation by Paris city authorities. The monument was closed late on Monday as employees held a meeting over the incident, which has angered staff and drawn criticism from French politicians. On Saturday, a delegation of about 100 people linked to the Hindu group Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha, or BAPS, made a private visit to the Eiffel Tower. "As the delegation passed through, women were asked to leave their workstations so that men could take their places," Diane Davoine, a union representative, told Reuters. "Tensions mounted over the weekend, so this morning, the employees decided to meet: first, to open a dialogue with management, and second, to ensure that women are never treated this way at the company again," she said. Signs at the base of the tower on Monday read: "The opening of the Eiffel Tower is delayed for operational reasons." Davoine said management apologised to staff over the incident. Paris Mayor Emmanuel Gregoire said that an investigation would be launched "as soon as possible". In a post on social media platform X, he said he was aware of the employees' anger and agreed their dissatisfaction was legitimate. "It is urgent that all light be shed on the facts that led to this protest," Gregoire wrote. BAPS, whose representatives were in France for festivities related to the inauguration of a Hindu temple in the Paris suburbs, said in a statement that the visit to the Eiffel Tower was arranged at the start of opening hours to avoid disrupting others, due to the size of its delegation. "To the best of our knowledge, at no point was anyone prevented access to the Eiffel Tower. Nevertheless, we sincerely apologise for any pain or inconvenience caused," the statement said. A spokesperson for SETE, the company operating the monument, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Yael Braun-Pivet, the president of the National Assembly, wrote in a post on X: "Welcoming others never means giving up our values. In France, women are fully present in public life. No one tells them to become invisible."

item.title: Trump says Canada's Bombardier cannot sell in US unless it builds there
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Monday that Canadian private jet maker Bombardier would no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the United States unless it started manufacturing in the country.
item.dc:creator: Bhargav Acharya, Allison Lampert
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Monday that Canadian private jet maker Bombardier (BBDb.TO) would no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the United States unless it started manufacturing in the country. "NO MORE SELLING BOMBARDIER IN THE UNITED STATES! Their products aren’t good enough!" Trump said in a post on Truth Social. "If they want our Market, they must build here, and stop treating America like a 'piggybank',” he said. Trump's post comes amid a growing trade dispute between Washington and Ottawa, one of [USN:L6N43Q08M TEXT:"many economic policies"] in his second term, especially a near global tariff-wall, that have drawn complaints from many US trading partners. Canada [USN:SPN44J009 TEXT:"is set"] to introduce a wave of counter tariffs against the United States on Tuesday. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment on how Trump would enforce the action or the steps he would take to bar deliveries of Bombardier jets which have been approved by the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration. The planemaker's jets also comply with the United States Mexico Canada (USMCA) trade deal that Trump helped implement. U.S. aerospace analyst Richard Aboulafia said he did not believe any business jet customers would cancel Bombardier orders and didn't see how Trump could stop them from being sold. Aboulafia pointed out that most Bombardier private jets use U.S. engines, which are produced by both Honeywell Aerospace (HONA.O) and GE Aerospace (GE.N) . Aerospace has largely emerged unscathed from Trump's tariff war with the flow of parts and planes not currently impacted by duties. According to U.S. trade group Aerospace Industries Association, the country's aerospace and defense sector has a $109.2 billion trade surplus, with exports up 25% on an annual basis in 2025. Like the U.S. auto sector, which depends on parts production by its northern neighbor, aerospace is highly integrated on a global scale. Bombardier, the Montreal-based rival of U.S. business jet manufacturer Gulfstream Aerospace (GD.N) , has an American workforce of 3,500, and a U.S. footprint of 2,800 suppliers, along with factories and service centers in the country. The company is now adding its sixth U.S. service center and produces wings for its flagship Global 8000 jet in Texas. Bombardier also has a defense division with a US-based factory in Kansas where it prepares Canadian-manufactured planes for special mission purposes. About half of the fleet of 5,100 aircraft operated by Bombardier customers are located in the US. The company did not immediately respond to requests for comment. In January, Trump said the U.S. was decertifying Bombardier Global Express business jets and threatened 50% import tariffs on all aircraft made in Canada until the country's regulator certified a number of planes produced by Gulfstream. Neither occurred, but [USN:L1N3ZK0S8 TEXT:"the next month Canada certified"] several Gulfstream planes. In July, Bombardier reported that its [USN:L1N43W01S TEXT:"quarterly revenue grew 6%"] compared with the same three months a year ago to $2.15 billion, helped by strong demand for aftermarket services.

item.title: Airbus aircraft deliveries to end-August rose 9%
item.description: Airbus jet deliveries rose 9% in the first eight months of 2026, leaving the European planemaker broadly on track to meet its target for the year, but with some catching-up to do on its A330 jet following a production snag, data showed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Airbus (AIR.PA) jet deliveries rose 9% in the first eight months of 2026, leaving the European planemaker broadly on track to meet its target for the year, but with some catching-up to do on its A330 jet following a production snag, data showed on Monday. Airbus said in a monthly bulletin that it had delivered 475 jets between January and August, up from 434 in the same period of last year. The tally included 57 deliveries in August. Data released by the France-based company showed that deliveries of the A330 wide-body jet resumed with one handover in August, after deliveries had been suspended in June and July following the [USN:L1N44V0ES TEXT:"discovery of a lost tool"] in an A330 tail section. Airbus has so far delivered 11 A330s this year, down 31%. Deliveries of the benchmark A320-family narrowbody rose 11%. The company is targeting 870 deliveries in 2026, up 10% from 793 last year. The planemaker sold 67 planes in August, including eight A350F freighters to an undisclosed customer. So far this year, it has sold 1,157 jets or 1,091 after adjusting for cancellations.

item.title: Andreeva extends deepest US Open run into quarters
item.description: Russian fifth seed Mirra Andreeva fought back to beat Austrian Anastasia Potapova 5-7 6-4 6-3 on Monday and extend her deepest run at the U.S. Open into the quarter-finals.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Russian fifth seed Mirra Andreeva fought back to beat Austrian Anastasia Potapova 5-7 6-4 6-3 on Monday and extend her deepest run at the U.S. Open into the quarter-finals. The 19-year-old Andreeva had her opponent on the ropes when Potapova went down with an apparent leg injury late in the match, putting a disappointing end to an otherwise competitive affair. "She's my good friend and seeing what a battle we had... seeing her fall like this, it's not easy," said Andreeva. "It's not the way obviously you want to finish the match... I just told her she's been playing amazing so far." The Roland Garros winner will next play the winner of an all-American clash between Iva Jovic and Coco Gauff. Potapova put up less than half as many unforced errors as her opponent in a tightly fought opening set, where Andreeva could not hang on when it counted the most, helping her opponent to the critical break in the final game with two double faults and a misfiring backhand. But the Russian cleaned up her form considerably in the second set, thriving in the shorter rallies before Potapova handed over the decisive break with a double fault in the seventh game. Andreeva broke her opponent from the baseline to go up 2-1 in the final set, where Potapova collapsed onto the court clutching her left knee in pain after chasing a ball along the baseline in the ninth game. Andreeva ran to her aid and helped her limp to her bench. She lay on the court for several minutes as a physio taped up her leg and valiantly finished the match, as Andreeva clinched it with a backhand winner before going to the other side of the court to embrace her opponent. "She's a better fighter than me so I'm sure she's going to come back even stronger," said Andreeva.

item.title: Lynx sign former No. 3 overall pick G Aari McDonald
item.description: The Minnesota Lynx signed veteran guard Aari McDonald on Monday. Terms were not disclosed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Minnesota Lynx signed veteran guard Aari McDonald on Monday. Terms were not disclosed. McDonald, 28, last played in the WNBA for the Indiana Fever in 2025 and was the No. 3 overall pick in the 2021 draft by the Atlanta Dream. She has career averages of 8.8 points and 3.1 assists in 136 games (42 starts) with the Dream (2021-23), Los Angeles Sparks (2024) and Fever. McDonald sustained a season-ending injury to her right foot during Indiana's Aug. 7, 2025 loss at Phoenix. In a corresponding move, the league-leading Lynx (31-9) waived guard Eliska Joklova. --Field Level Media

item.title: Europe’s biggest mobile operators in talks for satellite-to-mobile venture, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: Deutsche Telekom , Orange , Vodafone Group and Telefonica are in early talks to create a consortium to bid on European Union satellite spectrum and offer direct-to-mobile services, Bloomberg News reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Deutsche Telekom (DTEGn.DE) , Orange (ORAN.PA) , Vodafone Group (VOD.L) and Telefonica (TEF.MC) are in early talks to create a consortium to bid on European Union satellite spectrum and offer direct-to-mobile services, Bloomberg News reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter. The group would jointly bid for a share of 2 gigahertz airwaves that the EU has proposed reserving for a local operator, a plan aimed at increasing sovereign satellite capabilities, the report added. No final decisions on the consortium or plans to bid have been made, Bloomberg said. Vodafone, Orange, and Telefonica declined to comment, while Deutsche Telekom did not immediately respond to requests for comment. In May, the [USN:L8N4240UA TEXT:"European Union"] announced plans to allocate the bulk of valuable satellite spectrum for mobile phone service to European companies while reducing the share that U.S. operators can acquire, in a push to promote domestic businesses and reduce reliance on Big Tech. The European Commission designated two-thirds of the spectrum on the bloc's IRIS² multi-orbit array of 290 satellites for commercial use, divided equally between EU and non-EU operators. The consortium would bid on the EU operator portion. IRIS² is Europe's response to Starlink, and is led by the European Commission and a consortium made up of SES SA (SESFg.LU) , Eutelsat (ETL.PA) and HispaSat.

item.title: Indiana RB Khobie Martin (arm) out until midseason
item.description: Indiana running back Khobie Martin will be out until midseason with an apparent arm injury, coach Curt Cignetti confirmed Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indiana running back Khobie Martin will be out until midseason with an apparent arm injury, coach Curt Cignetti confirmed Monday. Martin appeared with his right arm in a sling in a social media post on Sunday, one day after leaving the Hoosiers' season-opening 52-16 rout of North Texas. The junior did not record a carry in the game. "Khobie Martin will be out a little bit," Cignetti said. "(We) expect him back midseason." Martin rushed 78 times for 505 yards (6.5-yard average) and six touchdowns in 14 games as Indiana marched to an undefeated national championship season in 2025. Turbo Richard (15 carries for 58 yards and two touchdowns) and Lee Beebe Jr. (14 carries for 33 yards) handled the rushing duties in Saturday's win in Bloomington, Ind. No. 6 Indiana (1-0) will host Howard (1-1) on Saturday at Memorial Stadium. --Field Level Media

item.title: Jaguar Land Rover cortará quase 10% da força de trabalho em plano de recuperação
item.description: A britânica Jaguar Land Rover anunciou nesta segunda-feira que cortará quase 10% de sua força de trabalho por meio de demissões voluntárias nos próximos dois anos, à medida que a indústria automotiva enfrenta pressões crescentes, incluindo a concorrência chinesa e tarifas.
item.dc:creator: Sam Tabahriti
item.content:encoded: A britânica Jaguar Land Rover anunciou nesta segunda-feira que cortará quase 10% de sua força de trabalho por meio de demissões voluntárias nos próximos dois anos, à medida que a indústria automotiva enfrenta pressões crescentes, incluindo a concorrência chinesa e tarifas. A montadora de carros de luxo, que é controlada pela indiana Tata Motors (TAMO.NS) e possui 17 unidades na Inglaterra, informou que cortará cerca de 4.000 empregos, com a meta de economizar 1,7 bilhão de libras e buscando reduzir seu ponto de equilíbrio (break-even) para 300 mil veículos. A JLR emprega perto de 43 mil pessoas em todo o mundo, incluindo 34 mil no Reino Unido, mas não informou onde os cortes de pessoal ocorrerão. “A indústria automotiva enfrenta desafios significativos, com mudanças tecnológicas em meio a intensa concorrência e incertezas geopolíticas contínuas”, afirmou o diretor executivo da JLR, PB Balaji, em comunicado. Na semana passada, a montadora alemã Volkswagen [USN:L4N44V1K1 TEXT:"aprovou"] planos para cortar mais 50.000 empregos, em uma tentativa de enfrentar tarifas onerosas, excesso de capacidade e rivais chineses agressivos. A JLR também está se recuperando de um ataque cibernético devastador que forçou uma [USN:L8N3WP0A6 TEXT:"paralisação"] prolongada [USN:L8N3WP0A6 TEXT:"da produção"] e afetou fornecedores em 2025. Os cortes de pessoal são um golpe para o governo do Reino Unido, que tenta impulsionar uma economia em crescimento lento. O ministro das Finanças, John Healey, [USN:L1N44Z06Z TEXT:"proferiu um discurso"] na segunda-feira a poucas milhas da sede da JLR em Coventry, no qual tentou traçar uma visão mais otimista do futuro econômico do país antes do que se espera ser um orçamento difícil no final de outubro. A JLR afirmou que lançará cinco novos produtos nos próximos 12 meses e continuará investindo entre 15 bilhões e 18 bilhões de libras nos próximos cinco anos em eletrificação, tecnologias digitais, manufatura avançada e melhorias na experiência do cliente. No entanto, a empresa afirmou que precisa realizar economias e simplificar sua estrutura para tornar o negócio mais resiliente. O programa de demissão voluntária afetará principalmente 26.000 funcionários da JLR, entre assalariados e gestores. (Reportagem de Sam Tabahriti)

item.title: Hadjar still out for Spanish Grand Prix, Lawson stands in again
item.description: Injured French driver Isack Hadjar will miss his third Formula One race in a row this weekend with Liam Lawson again standing in at Red Bull for the Spanish Grand Prix and Yuki Tsunoda continuing as the New Zealander's replacement at Racing Bulls.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Injured French driver Isack Hadjar will miss his third Formula One race in a row this weekend with Liam Lawson again standing in at Red Bull for the Spanish Grand Prix and Yuki Tsunoda continuing as the New Zealander's replacement at Racing Bulls. Both teams issued statements on Monday, the day after the Italian Grand Prix at Monza. Hadjar [USN:L6N44U0Z3 TEXT:"missed that race"] and the Dutch Grand Prix before it after he suffered a wrist injury while training last month. "The decision has been taken as Isack's recovery continues to progress positively," said Red Bull, who had four-time world champion Max Verstappen finish third at Monza. "While he is not yet ready to return to the cockpit, he will be in Madrid supporting the team." Tsunoda has stepped up from his role as reserve driver and the Japanese will partner British rookie Arvid Lindblad at Racing Bulls. The Madring is making its Formula One debut this weekend as the new home of the Spanish Grand Prix, previously hosted by Barcelona's Circuit de Catalunya.

item.title: Canciller cubano dice que no hay negociaciones con EEUU pese a bloqueo "genocida"
item.description: El máximo representante diplomático de Cuba dijo el lunes que no hay conversaciones en curso con Estados Unidos, ni planes para futuras negociaciones, en medio de un bloqueo "genocida" que, según Cuba, ha supuesto a la nación insular más de 8.000 millones de dólares en pérdidas económicas durante el último año.
item.dc:creator: Ayose Naranjo
item.content:encoded: El máximo representante diplomático de Cuba dijo el lunes que no hay conversaciones en curso con Estados Unidos, ni planes para futuras negociaciones, en medio de un bloqueo "genocida" que, según Cuba, ha supuesto a la nación insular más de 8.000 millones de dólares en pérdidas económicas durante el último año. "No hay negociaciones ni agendas, aunque se mantiene la disposición de mantener esos contactos a pesar de la falta de progresos", dijo el canciller de Cuba, Bruno Rodríguez, a periodistas en una rueda de prensa celebrada en La Habana. Rodríguez señaló que los daños causados por el embargo comercial estadounidense contra Cuba, que se remonta a décadas, se habían disparado un 7% en 2025 con respecto al año anterior, hasta alcanzar los 8.100 millones de dólares. Rodríguez señaló que el impacto financiero en la economía cubana se dispararía en los primeros meses de 2026, después de que el Gobierno de Trump impuso un bloqueo petrolero a la isla que prácticamente ha diezmado la producción y ha provocado apagones a nivel nacional que ahora se prolongan durante días. "El bloqueo no castiga a un Gobierno, castiga la vida cotidiana de un pueblo en todos los ámbitos", dijo el máximo representante diplomático de Cuba. "Es un acto que se expresa en los largos meses viviendo con solo 2 o 3 horas diarias de electricidad o menos, o en los alimentos echándose a perder, el calor que no deja dormir, los niños en penumbra haciendo sus tareas escolares", agregó. El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre las declaraciones de Rodríguez. Estados Unidos, que considera que el Gobierno cubano supone una amenaza para la seguridad nacional, ha dicho antes que el bloqueo y el endurecimiento de las sanciones son necesarios para forzar un cambio en el Gobierno comunista, al que el Gobierno de Trump acusa de limitar los derechos económicos y humanos de los cubanos. Las Naciones Unidas han calificado las sanciones de Trump y el asedio energético como una violación del derecho internacional. En agosto, un equipo de expertos de la ONU advirtió del creciente riesgo de brotes de enfermedades en la isla a medida que Estados Unidos endurecía las sanciones. Estados Unidos también advirtió recientemente, en una alerta sanitaria, de un repunte de las enfermedades intestinales y la diarrea causadas por las deficiencias en el suministro de agua y electricidad en la isla.

item.title: Bolsas europeas cierran estables; alza del petróleo pone atención en las tasas de interés del BCE
item.description: Las bolsas europeas cerraron sin cambios el lunes ya que el alza de los precios del petróleo, provocada por el recrudecimiento de la tensión entre Estados Unidos e Irán, avivó el temor a la inflación, lo que contrarrestó los datos económicos de la zona del euro que fueron mejores de lo esperado.
item.dc:creator: Medha Singh, Ragini Mathur
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas cerraron sin cambios el lunes ya que el alza de los precios del petróleo, provocada por el recrudecimiento de la tensión entre Estados Unidos e Irán, avivó el temor a la inflación, lo que contrarrestó los datos económicos de la zona del euro que fueron mejores de lo esperado. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) cerró en 649,9 puntos. El principal índice suizo (.SSMI) cayó un 0,8%. Novartis (NOVN.S) , una de las empresas de mayor peso, bajó un 3,2% después de que su medicamento contra el colesterol no superó un estudio que se seguía con gran interés. El DAX alemán (.GDAXI) bajó un 0,2%. Durante el fin de semana, el partido de extrema derecha AfD se impuso en las elecciones regionales de Sajonia-Anhalt con un 44% de los votos, lo que supuso un duro golpe para el canciller Friedrich Merz. Aún no está claro si AfD podrá formar gobierno en el estado, ya que no alcanzó la mayoría absoluta. El partido aboga por restricciones más estrictas a la inmigración, vínculos más estrechos con Rusia, una reducción del apoyo a Ucrania y la salida del euro. "La histórica victoria de AfD en Sajonia-Anhalt ha hecho que el DAX baje ligeramente, pero la moderada reacción sugiere que los inversores ven el resultado como una advertencia política más que como una amenaza económica inmediata", afirmó Axel Rudolph, analista técnico jefe de IG. Las preocupaciones fiscales de cara a las elecciones del próximo año llevaron a las acciones francesas (.FCHI) a mínimos de dos meses la semana pasada. El índice bursátil subió un 0,3% el lunes. Las acciones del sector energético (.SXEP) subieron un 1,2%, siguiendo la tendencia al alza de los precios del petróleo. Los futuros del Brent rondaban los 100 dólares por barril ya que los ataques a buques en el estrecho de Ormuz y en otros lugares avivaron los temores de interrupciones en el suministro. Los datos ofrecieron cierto apoyo a la economía regional. La confianza de los inversores de la zona del euro alcanzó en septiembre su nivel más alto en más de cuatro años, mientras que el PIB del segundo trimestre creció un 0,6% respecto al trimestre anterior y un 1,2% interanual, cifras que superaron las expectativas en ambos casos. Los volúmenes de negociación fueron escasos, ya que los mercados estadounidenses permanecieron cerrados por festivo. El aumento de los precios del petróleo ha avivado los temores por la inflación, lo que desencadenó una ola de ventas de bonos a nivel mundial la semana pasada y reforzó los argumentos a favor de un mayor endurecimiento de la política monetaria. Se espera que el Banco Central Europeo suba las tasas en 25 puntos básicos el jueves, mientras que los datos del IPC de Estados Unidos de esta semana cobran protagonismo después que un sólido reporte sobre el empleo impulsó las expectativas de un alza de tasas por parte de la Fed.

item.title: UK's Burnham, Trump discuss working towards Ukraine-Russia ceasefire, Downing Street says
item.description: Britain's Prime Minister Andy Burnham spoke with U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday, with the two leaders agreeing on "the need to continue working towards a ceasefire" to end Russia's war in Ukraine, Downing Street said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's Prime Minister Andy Burnham spoke with U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday, with the two leaders agreeing on "the need to continue working towards a ceasefire" to end Russia's war in Ukraine, Downing Street said. "The Prime Minister reiterated the UK's support for Ukraine and for recent U.S.-led peace negotiations," a Downing Street spokesperson said. Burnham and Trump also discussed the Middle East, with Burnham "stressing the importance of the two-state solution, the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and ensuring that Iran never acquires a nuclear weapon", the spokesperson added. Monday's call comes after U.S. peace envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff [USN:L1N44Y03K TEXT:"met the Ukrainian President"] Volodymyr Zelenskiy in Kyiv on Sunday, having [USN:L1N44X01Y TEXT:"spoken with Russian President"] Vladimir Putin in Moscow on Saturday.

item.title: Haiti gangs shift operations into countryside, report says
item.description: Haiti's armed gangs are increasingly expanding from Port-au-Prince into rural areas, adopting hit-and-run tactics including kidnappings, cattle theft and roadblocks while security and political responses remain focused on the capital, a new report said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Haiti's armed gangs are increasingly expanding from Port-au-Prince into rural areas, adopting hit-and-run tactics including kidnappings, cattle theft and roadblocks while security and political responses remain focused on the capital, a new report said on Monday. The analysis, published by the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime's Haiti Observatory, said the shift amounts to more than an extension of urban gang activity into the countryside. Gangs are using small, mobile units to carry out rapid raids, harass communities and move between areas serving as sanctuaries and targets, the report said. The approach allows armed groups to project influence and disrupt daily life without permanently occupying territory. The report cited the [USN:S0N43903K TEXT:"recent attack on Kenscoff"], a mountainous community outside Port-au-Prince, as an example of the changing nature of gang violence. The assault killed dozens of people and involved a mass kidnapping, it said. It also highlighted worsening insecurity in Artibonite, one of Haiti's main agricultural regions, where gangs have targeted communities, transport routes and farmland. The growing violence in rural areas poses a challenge for [USN:S0N41D00V TEXT:"Haitian security forces"], which the report said lack the personnel, equipment and training needed to counter highly mobile armed groups across mountainous and dispersed terrain. The report said a [USN:L1N3UL0PE TEXT:"security response alone"] would be insufficient, calling for measures to protect farmers, restore local economies and address long-running land and community disputes, alongside efforts to disarm and reintegrate gang members.

item.title: Antes de ato na Paulista, Flávio pede "espada da Justiça" de Deus na Praça dos Três Poderes
item.description: O senador e candidato à Presidência, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), pediu nesta segunda-feira que Deus atue com sua "espada da justiça" na Praça dos Três Poderes, antes de um ato pelo Dia da Independência na Avenida Paulista, que deve ser marcado pelo embate com o ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O senador e candidato à Presidência, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), pediu nesta segunda-feira que Deus atue com sua "espada da justiça" na Praça dos Três Poderes, antes de um ato pelo Dia da Independência na Avenida Paulista, que deve ser marcado pelo embate com o ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal. Ao fazer uma oração durante um culto na Igreja Mundial do Poder de Deus na região central de São Paulo, Flávio pediu ainda que Deus afaste os espíritos do mal do país. "Que o Senhor afaste todo espírito mau deste país, que o Senhor venha com a sua espada da justiça na Praça dos Três Poderes em Brasília para que a presença do Senhor possa mudar as autoridades desse país", afirmou o filho mais velho do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio deverá liderar um ato na Paulista, marcado para as 15h, no qual deve buscar fortalecer sua candidatura ao Planalto em meio à crise envolvendo o Supremo Tribunal Federal. A celebração do Dia da Independência na Paulista, também usada no passado por Jair Bolsonaro, deve ser marcada por críticas a Moraes após revelação, na semana passada, de mensagens em que o empresário Daniel Vorcaro, ex-dono do Banco Master, questiona Moraes se o ministro poderia reverter o andamento de investigações contra ele. Durante o governo Jair Bolsonaro, a Paulista e o Dia da Independência foram palcos de ataques do ex-presidente a Moraes. Em 2021, em discurso no 7 de setembro na Paulista, Bolsonaro, atualmente em prisão domiciliar por tentativa de golpe de Estado, chamou Moraes de "canalha" e disse que não cumpriria suas decisões. LULA EM BRASÍLIA Já o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva participou, na manhã desta segunda, do desfile de 7 de Setembro em Brasília, ao lado dos presidentes da Câmara dos Deputados, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) e do STF, Edson Fachin. O presidente não discursou no evento, que teve mensagens de defesa da soberania nacional durante o desfile. Na véspera, em pronunciamento em rede nacional, Lula voltou a bater na tecla da defesa da soberania, um dos principais motes de sua campanha, ao afirmar que o Brasil não pode "baixar a cabeça diante de potências estrangeiras que querem transformar o Brasil novamente em colônia" e que o Brasil é "um país soberano e nossas decisões pertencem a nós e a mais ninguém".

item.title: Vols LB Arion Carter turns suspension into fundraiser
item.description: Tennessee linebacker Arion Carter found a way to turn his NCAA suspension into something positive for others.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tennessee linebacker Arion Carter found a way to turn his NCAA suspension into something positive for others. The Volunteers senior is donating $427 for each tackle he makes this season to help pay bills for cancer patients, according to a story published Monday by On3.com. The amount is a not-so-subtle jab at the NCAA after being suspended for the season opener for receiving an improper benefit: a $427 plane ticket to an NFL pre-draft training facility, paid for by his agent which he repaid after the fact. Carter, who withdrew from the 2026 NFL Draft to return to Knoxville, will make his season debut Saturday night at Georgia Tech after sitting out No. 20 Tennessee's season-opening 56-9 win against Furman. "It was obviously hard not playing the sport that you love and that you put so much time and endearment into," Carter said. "But I feel like it gave me a different perspective on just the game and then life in general and just being able to have certain gratitude. So whenever you go out there and get your opportunity, make sure you take advantage of it." Carter is also donating $500 for each sack, $1,000 for each interception or forced fumble and $5,000 for each defensive touchdown he scores. Donations will go to such charities as Sisters Network Nashville, which raises money to pay medical bills for those battling cancer. Carter said he was inspired by his girlfriend, Mariah Bryant, who is battling breast cancer. He is partnering with his mother's nonprofit, Girls in Real Life Situations, to coordinate the fundraising efforts. "For me, it means a lot," Carter said. "I like to always think of it as an opportunity now to go out there and put on display what I've been working so hard on this off season. It just means a lot more to me to know that the fans that were backing me in the whole Vol nation supporting me throughout the whole situation. It means a lot to me. I can't wait to go out there and repay the favor with the way I play on Saturday and the rest of this season." As a junior in 2025, Carter led the Southeastern Conference with 7.6 tackles per game and earned all-conference honors. He recorded 76 tackles, six tackles for loss and 1.5 sacks in 10 games last season, and has 161 tackles, 13.5 tackles for loss, one forced fumble, one fumble recovery and one interception in 31 career games with the Vols. --Field Level Media

item.title: Investigators recover black boxes from cargo plane crash in Miami
item.description: Investigators with the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board said on Monday they had recovered the flight data recorder and cockpit voice recorder from an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane that overran the runway and crashed while landing in Miami on Sunday, killing five people on the ground.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Trotta
item.content:encoded: Investigators with the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board said on Monday they had recovered the flight data recorder and cockpit voice recorder from an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane that overran the runway and crashed while landing in Miami on Sunday, killing five people on the ground. NTSB Chairwoman Jennifer Homendy said the two devices, commonly referred to as the black boxes, were being returned to the agency's headquarters in Washington on Monday night for evaluation. The 32-year-old Boeing 767-33A, operated by Miami-based 21 Air LLC, overran the runway by some 1,300 feet (396 meters) and crashed into two vehicles on the ground: an Econoline van on the airport grounds carrying seven people from an airline cleaning crew and a Toyota SUV that was driving on a road beyond the perimeter fence. The two people aboard the plane, the pilot and co-pilot, survived and had yet to be interviewed, Homendy said in a press conference. Five people were injured, three of them critically, officials said on Sunday. Homendy, leading a team of 32 investigators at Miami International Airport, briefed reporters on the early stages of the investigation but said a probable cause of the accident would not be determined until the end of the investigation. The NTSB was still recovering and recording evidence, and crews were still removing jet fuel from the scene and aircraft, keeping two of the airport's four runways closed. Although the airport halted all flights immediately after the crash, flights had resumed by Sunday evening. Asked to describe the scene, Homendy responded: "Utter devastation." "You can see on the paved surface tire marks that continue through the grass. There's debris everywhere. The Econoline van is torn apart," Homendy said. "The SUV, you can see airbags, the surrounding airbags. You can see components from the vehicles, both passenger vehicles and the aircraft." Reuters photos showed the jet with its nose on the ground and tail tilted up. The right side of the plane had what appeared to be scorch marks. Homendy did not offer details on who was killed in the crash, but said they were from the two vehicles struck on the ground. The van contained a team from Professional Ocean Service Corp, which provides cleaning services for airlines, and the SUV beyond the airport perimeter fence was traveling on Northwest 67th Avenue, she said. The Amazon cargo plane was on its third flight of the day, coming from San Juan, Puerto Rico. It had flown from Cincinnati to Miami, and from Miami to San Juan, earlier on Sunday before the crash at 1:53 p.m. EDT (1753 GMT), Homendy said. Part of the NTSB investigation will examine the significance of the lack of runway material designed to stop runaway aircraft. Not every U.S. airport has an Engineered Materials Arresting System, or EMAS. Homendy also asked the public to send in any photos or videos of the scene, saying those images could aid the investigation.

item.title: Bolívia confirma 7 mortes e outras pessoas ainda estão desaparecidas após explosão em base militar
item.description: As autoridades bolivianas confirmaram nesta segunda-feira que sete pessoas morreram após uma explosão ocorrida na sexta-feira em uma base militar no município boliviano de Viacha, a cerca de 30 km de La Paz.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As autoridades bolivianas confirmaram nesta segunda-feira que sete pessoas morreram após uma [USN:S0N42V05B TEXT:"explosão"] ocorrida na sexta-feira em uma base militar no município boliviano de Viacha, a cerca de 30 km de La Paz. O comandante do Exército, Héctor Alarcón, afirmou em uma coletiva de imprensa que sete pessoas ainda estavam desaparecidas. “Nossa prioridade continua sendo encontrar nossos companheiros que ainda estão desaparecidos e dar respostas às suas famílias o mais rápido possível”, disse Alarcón. A ministra da Saúde, Marcela Flores, informou que 84 pacientes foram atendidos desde a explosão na sexta-feira, e 31 pessoas continuam hospitalizadas. O presidente da Bolívia, [USN:L6N42R001 TEXT:"Rodrigo Paz"], disse que a causa da explosão está sendo investigada, mas parece ter sido um acidente causado pelo manuseio inadequado de explosivos armazenados nas instalações militares. “Nossas Forças Armadas estão revisando seus protocolos e tudo o que for necessário para garantir maior segurança, não apenas para os soldados e oficiais, mas também para os moradores que vivem próximos às bases militares”, disse Paz. Ele também anunciou um período de luto nacional e pediu que as pessoas não politizassem a tragédia. A explosão ocorreu por volta das 14h30 (horário local) desta sexta-feira em uma área usada para armazenar material pirotécnico, informaram as autoridades. (Reportagem de Daniel Ramos e Mônica Machicao; texto de Daina Beth Solomon)

item.title: Letônia planeja tarifa de 300% sobre grãos da Rússia e Bielorrússia
item.description: O governo da Letônia planeja impor uma tarifa de 300% sobre os grãos provenientes da Rússia e da Bielorrússia, afirmou nesta segunda-feira o primeiro-ministro do país báltico, Andris Kulbergs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O governo da Letônia planeja impor uma tarifa de 300% sobre os grãos provenientes da Rússia e da Bielorrússia, afirmou nesta segunda-feira o primeiro-ministro do país báltico, Andris Kulbergs. Autoridades da Letônia e da vizinha Lituânia afirmaram na semana passada que [USN:L8N44W17M TEXT:"consideravam interromper os embarques"] de grãos russos por meio de seus portos, depois que Moscou intensificou os trânsitos em resposta aos ataques da Ucrânia aos portos bálticos russos. Exportadores russos estão transportando grãos pela Letônia, membro da UE e da Otan, para outros mercados, segundo analistas e comerciantes. Uma proibição ou tarifas elevadas poderiam cortar uma alternativa fundamental, em um momento em que as rotas do Mar Negro e do Mar de Azov estão paralisadas por ataques de drones ucranianos. A Rússia exportou 46,3 milhões de toneladas de grãos pelos portos do Mar de Azov e do Mar Negro na última safra de exportação, de julho de 2025 a junho de 2026, o que representou 90% do total das exportações marítimas de grãos da Rússia, segundo dados do setor. (Reportagem de Andrius Sytas)

item.content:encoded: Mamad Mohamad observó con sentimientos encontrados cómo el partido de extrema derecha Alternativa para Alemania (AfD) se alzaba con una victoria histórica el domingo por la noche en el estado oriental de Sajonia-Anhalt. Este militante de Los Verdes, de 46 años, está a punto de convertirse en uno de los primeros diputados de origen inmigrante en entrar en el parlamento regional, junto con Mustafa Groener, del partido La Izquierda (Die Linke). Para Mohamad, que llegó a Alemania procedente de Siria en 1996 como un kurdo yazidí de 16 años, era un hito que debería haber sido motivo de celebración. En cambio, lo describió como un "caliz envenenado". "Tenía el corazón partido", dijo Mohamad, sobre las primeras proyecciones que mostraban que la AfD superaba las expectativas, mientras que los conservadores del canciller Friedrich Merz caían a un mínimo histórico. "CULTURALMENTE AJENO" La AfD lleva mucho tiempo haciendo campaña a favor de políticas de inmigración y asilo más estrictas, argumentando que Alemania ha perdido el control de sus fronteras y que la migración está ejerciendo una fuerte presión sobre los servicios públicos, la seguridad y la cohesión social. Según su programa electoral, una Sajonia-Anhalt gobernada por la AfD pondría en marcha una campaña a nivel regional para deportar a los solicitantes de asilo rechazados. El partido también propone animar a las empresas a adoptar la inteligencia artificial y la automatización en lugar de depender de la inmigración cualificada procedente de lo que describe como entornos "culturalmente ajenos". La AfD rechaza las acusaciones de que su retórica contribuye a crear un clima hostil para los migrantes, insistiendo en que solo se opone a la inmigración ilegal y descontrolada. "Damos una calurosa bienvenida a todo aquel que contribuya positivamente a nuestra sociedad, que quiera trabajar aquí, que esté cualificado, que pague impuestos y que respete la ley", dijo el lunes la copresidenta de la AfD, Alice Weidel. MALETAS HECHAS El lunes reinaba un ambiente sombrío en la familia de Mohamad. Según él, su hija se mostraba reacia a ir al colegio, uno de los muchos criticados por la AfD por sus proyectos que analizan las amenazas a la democracia. Aunque la ansiedad es alta en muchas comunidades de inmigrantes, el resultado ha provocado más inquietud que sorpresa, dijo Undra Dressler, directora general de la Red Estatal de Organizaciones de Inmigrantes de Sajonia-Anhalt. Las personas de origen inmigrante llevan mucho tiempo enfrentándose a la discriminación y a barreras estructurales en el acceso al trabajo, la educación, la sanidad y los servicios públicos, señaló Dressler. "Todo esto es nuestra realidad", dijo a Reuters. No obstante, el resultado del domingo marca un punto de inflexión, añadió. "Hay muchas personas en nuestras comunidades que dicen: 'Ya hemos hecho las maletas y tenemos planes concretos, y nos marcharemos pronto', o, en algunos casos, ya se han marchado". Pascal Begrich, director general del grupo de defensa de la democracia Miteinander, dijo que no esperaba un éxodo a gran escala, en parte debido a las realidades económicas, pero coincidió en que muchos inmigrantes, así como también muchos empresarios, estaban replanteándose su futuro en Sajonia-Anhalt. "Hay empresas que se preguntan si realmente quieren establecerse aquí y si pueden garantizar la seguridad de sus trabajadores", dijo Begrich a Reuters. LÍMITES CONSTITUCIONALES Mohamad dijo que temía que el giro político dificulte la captación de nuevos residentes en un estado que ya se enfrenta a un declive demográfico. "Los trabajadores cualificados y las familias buscarán otros lugares", agregó. A pesar de las preocupaciones sobre la orientación política del estado, tanto Dressler como Begrich subrayaron que cualquier futuro gobierno seguiría estando sujeto al orden constitucional alemán y a las protecciones para las minorías. "Todo gobierno está sujeto a ello", señaló Dressler. "Y los otros quince estados federados tienen el deber de velar por ello y, si es necesario, intervenir".

item.title: Fiorentina turn to familiar face Vanoli after sacking Grosso
item.description: Fiorentina brought back Paolo Vanoli as coach on Monday, a day after showing former World Cup winner Fabio Grosso the door following a nightmare start three games into the new Serie A season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Fiorentina brought back Paolo Vanoli as coach on Monday, a day after showing former World Cup winner Fabio Grosso the door following a nightmare start three games into the new Serie A season. Grosso was [USN:L8N44Y0CB TEXT:"dismissed after three successive defeats"] left Fiorentina bottom of the league standings, with the team scoring only one goal while conceding nine. The appointment marks a swift return for Vanoli, who previously rescued the club from relegation trouble last season after replacing Stefano Pioli in November following a winless 10-game start. He eventually guided them clear of the drop zone to a 15th-place finish while also steering the club to the Conference League quarter-finals where they were knocked out by eventual winners Crystal Palace. "ACF Fiorentina announces that Coach Paolo Vanoli has been appointed as the new technical director of the Viola first team," the club said in a statement. "A huge thank you goes to the coach for his enthusiastic acceptance of returning to lead the first team." Vanoli will get his first chance to turn things around on Friday when Fiorentina travel to face promoted Venezia, who are also winless after three games with no points.

item.title: El retiro de escombros de Gaza por parte de Israel podría destruir "evidencia", dice experta de la ONU
item.description: Una experta de la ONU dijo el lunes que la retirada de escombros por parte de Israel en Gaza podría destruir pruebas valiosas de "crímenes atroces" e impedir la recuperación de restos humanos.
item.dc:creator: Emma Farge
item.content:encoded: Una experta de la ONU dijo el lunes que la retirada de escombros por parte de Israel en Gaza podría destruir pruebas valiosas de "crímenes atroces" e impedir la recuperación de restos humanos. El ataque de Israel contra Gaza —iniciado tras la mortífera incursión de Hamás en Israel en octubre de 2023— ha generado alrededor de 61 millones de toneladas de escombros y restos que podrían tardar siete años en retirarse, según las Naciones Unidas. Francesca Albanese, experta de la ONU en los territorios palestinos, señaló que se deberían recopilar las pruebas e identificar los restos humanos antes de que comience la limpieza total. Emitió un comunicado titulado: "Una experta de la ONU advierte que la limpieza de escombros por parte de Israel podría borrar rastros de crímenes atroces" y señaló que los palestinos deberían estar al frente de cualquier plan para retirar los escombros. "En la devastada Gaza, los escombros no son solo residuos de construcción. Forman parte de la escena del crimen, de un cementerio y constituyen el registro material de lo ocurrido durante una campaña de bombardeos brutal y sin sentido que duró dos años", afirmó. Señaló que múltiples fuentes habían confirmado que empresas israelíes participaban en la limpieza, sin nombrar dichas fuentes. Su oficina no respondió de inmediato a las preguntas sobre el origen de esa información. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Israel, la Oficina del Primer Ministro y el Ejército no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. En el pasado, todos ellos han mostrado un fuerte desacuerdo con Albanese, quien se ha erigido como una de las críticas más feroces de las acciones militares de Israel en Gaza. En febrero, Alemania, Francia e Italia condenaron lo que calificaron de declaraciones excesivamente negativas sobre Israel por parte de Albanese, aunque ella negó haber hecho los comentarios que le atribuían. En julio del año pasado, Estados Unidos impuso sanciones a Albanese por lo que, dijo, eran sus esfuerzos por instar a la Corte Penal Internacional a tomar medidas contra funcionarios, empresas y ejecutivos estadounidenses e israelíes. Los expertos de la ONU son designados por el Consejo de Derechos Humanos, con sede en Ginebra, para supervisar y documentar crisis específicas de derechos humanos, pero son independientes de la propia organización. Los ataques liderados por Hamás en 2023 se saldaron con 1.200 muertos en Israel, mientras que otras 251 personas fueron tomadas como rehenes, según las cifras israelíes. Más de 73.000 palestinos han perdido la vida en la campaña militar de Israel, según las autoridades sanitarias de Gaza. Israel dice que ha hecho todo lo posible por evitar víctimas civiles y que Hamás utiliza a la población civil de Gaza como escudos humanos en zonas densamente pobladas, una acusación que Hamás niega. Las autoridades palestinas estiman que más de 8.000 personas siguen sepultadas bajo los escombros. Un equipo de rescate palestino que peinó los escombros en la ciudad de Gaza el mes pasado afirmó haber encontrado los restos de 112 personas pertenecientes al mismo clan.

item.title: Chile debe priorizar productividad de fundiciones antes que agregar capacidad: estatal Cochilco
item.description: Chile debe concentrar sus esfuerzos en elevar la productividad y uso de sus fundiciones de cobre antes de impulsar nueva capacidad, en medio de un cada vez más ajustado mercado global de concentrados, según un estudio de la estatal Comisión Chilena del Cobre (Cochilco).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chile debe concentrar sus esfuerzos en elevar la productividad y uso de sus fundiciones de cobre antes de impulsar nueva capacidad, en medio de un cada vez más ajustado mercado global de concentrados, según un estudio de la estatal Comisión Chilena del Cobre (Cochilco). El documento señaló que la escasez y la expansión de fundiciones han llevado los TC/RC (costos de refinación y tratamiento) spot a niveles cercanos a cero o negativos y, aunque se recupere la oferta hacia 2028, el mercado custom (no integrado) seguiría ajustado. "La oportunidad inmediata consiste en recuperar continuidad operacional, disponibilidad y volumen tratado, antes de comprometer nuevas expansiones", plantea el estudio. El informe sostiene que, pese a contar con la mayor capacidad de fundición de América Latina, estimada en 5,44 millones de toneladas anuales de tratamiento, las instalaciones chilenas operan en torno al 60% de su capacidad nominal. El país sudamericano redujo su participación mundial en el mercado de cobre fundido desde 13,3% en 1990 a 4,2% en 2025. Cochilco dijo que la demanda ha sido impulsada por la transición energética y la entrada en operación de nuevas fundiciones, mientras que la oferta se ha visto limitada por menores leyes de mineral, retrasos en proyectos y disrupciones operacionales. El país continúa siendo un actor dominante y representó cerca del 23% de la producción mundial de concentrados en 2025, según el informe. Cerca de dos tercios de los envíos locales de concentrados se destinan a China, que concentra la mayor capacidad mundial de fundición. Si bien ese vínculo asegura acceso al principal mercado procesador del metal, también expone al país a cambios en la demanda, políticas industriales y condiciones comerciales definidas por Pekín. En Chile, actualmente operan las fundiciones de Caletones, Chuquicamata y Potrerillos de la estatal Codelco, Altonorte de Glencore y Chagres de Anglo American. Codelco mantiene un acuerdo con Glencore para evaluar la construcción de una nueva instalación, mientras la estatal ENAMI avanza en su plan de modernizar su antigua planta. El estudio acotó que nuevos proyectos de fundiciones podrían sumar 8,2 millones de toneladas de cobre fino anual al 2041, principalmente en Asia, intensificando la competencia por el abastecimiento de concentrados. "La expansión de capacidad de fundiciones de cobre en Chile requiere fundamentos técnicos, económicos, ambientales y operacionales que aseguren su viabilidad", aseguró.

item.title: Israeli clearance of Gaza rubble could destroy 'evidence', says UN expert
item.description: A U.N. expert said on Monday that Israeli clearance of rubble in Gaza could destroy valuable evidence of "atrocity crimes" and prevent the recovery of human remains.
item.dc:creator: Emma Farge
item.content:encoded: A U.N. expert said on Monday that Israeli clearance of rubble in Gaza could destroy valuable evidence of "atrocity crimes" and prevent the recovery of human remains. Israel's assault on Gaza — started after the deadly raid into Israel by Hamas in October 2023 — has generated around 61 million tons of [USN:L8N41A0F2 TEXT:"wreckage and debris"] that could take seven years to clear, according to the United Nations. Francesca Albanese, the U.N. expert on the Palestinian territories, said evidence should be gathered and human remains identified before full clearance started. She issued a statement headlined: "UN expert warns Israeli rubble-clearing could erase traces of atrocity crimes" and said Palestinians should be behind any plans to remove waste. "In devastated Gaza, rubble is not just construction waste. It is part of a crime scene, a graveyard, and the material record of what happened during a brutal and senseless bombing campaign that lasted two years,” she said. She said that multiple sources had confirmed Israeli companies were involved in the clearance, without naming those sources. Her office did not immediately respond to questions on where that information had come from. Israel's Foreign Ministry, its Prime Minister's Office and military did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In the past, all have fiercely disagreed with Albanese, who has emerged as one of the most vocal critics of Israel's military actions in Gaza. In February, Germany, France and Italy [USN:L6N3Z90MB TEXT:"all condemned"] what they said were her overly negative statements about Israel, though she denied making the remarks they cited. In July last year, the U.S. [USN:L1N41Y16Y TEXT:"imposed sanctions"] on Albanese over what it said were her efforts to prompt the International Criminal Court to take action against U.S. and Israeli officials, companies, and executives. U.N. experts are commissioned by the Geneva-based Human Rights Council to monitor and document specific human rights crises but are independent of the organisation itself. The 2023 Hamas-led attacks killed 1,200 people in Israel while another 251 were taken hostage, according to Israeli tallies. More than 73,000 Palestinians have been killed in Israel's military campaign, according to Gaza health authorities. Israel says it has gone to great lengths to avoid civilian casualties and that Hamas uses Gaza's civilians as human shields in densely populated areas - a claim Hamas denies. In a statement, Hamas said it appreciated Albanese's warning, and urged that the rubble be removed in a manner that "ensures the recovery of the remains of missing persons and the preservation of evidence." Palestinian authorities estimate more than 8,000 people remain buried in the wreckage. A Palestinian recovery team that combed through the wreckage in Gaza City last month said it [USN:L8N4400Z0 TEXT:"found the remains"] of 112 people from the same clan.

item.title: Far-right triumph in eastern Germany leaves migrants questioning their future
item.description: Mamad Mohamad watched with mixed emotions as the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) swept to a historic victory on Sunday evening in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt.
item.dc:creator: Friederike Heine
item.content:encoded: Mamad Mohamad watched with mixed emotions as the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) swept to a [USN:L1N44Z08Z TEXT:"historic victory"] on Sunday evening in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt. A member of the Greens, the 46-year-old is set to become one of the first lawmakers with an immigrant background to enter the state parliament, alongside Mustafa Groener of the Left (Die Linke) party. For Mohamad, who arrived in Germany from Syria as a 16-year-old Yazidi Kurd in 1996, it was a milestone that should have been a moment of celebration. Instead, he described it as a "poisoned victory". "My heart was split," Mohamad said, recalling the first projections that showed the AfD outperforming expectations while Chancellor Friedrich Merz's governing conservatives slumped to a historic low. 'CULTURALLY ALIEN' The AfD has long campaigned for tighter immigration and asylum policies, arguing that Germany has lost control of its borders and that migration is putting heavy pressure on public services, security and social cohesion. According to its [USN:L8N44U0P5 TEXT:"election manifesto"], an AfD-led Saxony-Anhalt would launch a state-level campaign to deport rejected asylum seekers. The party also proposes encouraging businesses to adopt artificial intelligence and automation rather than rely on skilled migration from what it describes as "culturally alien" backgrounds. The AfD rejects accusations that its rhetoric contributes to a hostile climate for migrants, insisting it opposes only illegal and uncontrolled migration. "Everyone is warmly welcome who contributes positively to our society, who wants to work here, who is qualified, who pays taxes, and who abides by the law," AfD co-leader Alice Weidel said on Monday. PACKED BAGS The mood in Mohamad's family was sombre on Monday. His daughter, he said, was reluctant to attend school, one of several criticised by the AfD over projects that examine threats to democracy. Though anxiety is running high in many immigrant communities, the result has prompted unease rather than surprise, said Undra Dressler, managing director of the State Network of Migrant Organisations in Saxony-Anhalt. People with migrant backgrounds have long faced discrimination and structural barriers in access to work, education, healthcare and public services, Dressler said. "All of this is our reality," she told Reuters. Sunday's result nevertheless marks a turning point, she said. "There are many people in our communities who say: 'We've already packed our bags and have concrete plans, and we'll be leaving soon,' or, in some cases, have already left." Pascal Begrich, managing director of democracy advocacy group Miteinander, said he did not expect a large-scale exodus, partly because of economic realities, but agreed that many migrants but also employers were reassessing their future in Saxony-Anhalt. "There are companies asking themselves whether they really want to locate here and whether they can ensure their workers will be safe," Begrich told Reuters. CONSTITUTIONAL LIMITS Mohamad said he feared the political shift could make it harder to attract newcomers to a state already grappling with demographic decline. "Skilled workers and families will look elsewhere," he said. Despite concerns about the state's political direction, both Dressler and Begrich stressed that any future government would remain bound by Germany's constitutional order and protections for minorities. "Every government is bound by this," Dressler said. "And the 15 other federal states have a duty to monitor this and, if necessary, to intervene."

item.title: Activos anotan leves cambios mientras se refuerzan apuestas a alza de tasas de Fed
item.description: Los mercados de América Latina anotaron leves movimientos el lunes, en una sesión de pocos negocios debido a un feriado en Estados Unidos por el Día del Trabajo, mientras se reforzaban las expectativas de un alza de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal (Fed) luego de un fuerte dato del empleo de la semana pasada.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: Los mercados de América Latina anotaron leves movimientos el lunes, en una sesión de pocos negocios debido a un feriado en Estados Unidos por el Día del Trabajo, mientras se reforzaban las expectativas de un alza de tasas por parte de la Reserva Federal (Fed) luego de un fuerte dato del empleo de la semana pasada. * Los operadores ahora ven un 58% de probabilidades de que haya una subida de las tasas de interés en la reunión de política monetaria de la Fed de la próxima semana, según la herramienta CME FedWatch, frente a una probabilidad del 50% antes de que se publicaran los datos de empleo el viernes. * Para esta semana se esperan los datos del índice de precios al productor de Estados Unidos que se publicaran el jueves y, al día siguiente, se espera el reporte de inflación de consumo, dato clave para definir la postura de la Fed respecto de los tipos de interés. * La atención de los mercados globales también se centró en Oriente Medio, donde los ataques recíprocos entre Estados Unidos e Irán contra buques que navegaban por el estrecho de Ormuz y otras zonas provocaban un alza en los precios del petróleo debido a una baja en los flujos. * El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde frente a una canasta de seis importantes monedas, bajaba alrededor de un 0,2%. * El peso mexicano cotizaba al cierre en 16,9320 por dólar, con una caída del 0,31%, en una jornada de liquidez reducida por el feriado en Estados Unidos, mientras los inversores esperaban además de los datos de inflación estadounidense y la presentación del presupuesto de México para el próximo año. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, bajaba un 0,27%, a 64.690,03 unidades. * En Argentina, el peso interbancario se depreció un 0,26% a 1.515,5 unidades por dólar. * "El dólar mayorista parece haber encontrado un nuevo techo en torno a los 1510/1515 pesos, con el Banco Central (BCRA) defendiendo esos valores", expresó Roberto Geretto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero. * En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires, cayó un 0,48%. Entre las principales bajas se destacaron las empresas del sector financiero. * El peso chileno , retrocedió un leve 0,09%, a 934,00/934,30 unidades por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , bajó apenas un 0,01%, a 11.451,80 puntos. * En Colombia el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) cerró con alza de un 0,82%, a 2.565,5 puntos, mientras que el mercado cambiario permanecía inactivo por el feriado en Estados Unidos. * Más temprano, el Banco Central colombiano informó de que durante agosto efectuó compras de títulos de deuda pública interna TES en el mercado por 1,6 billones de pesos (511,8 millones de dólares), al tiempo que adquirió 399,9 millones de dólares a través de subasta de opciones "put" para acumulación de reservas internacionales. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un 0,12%, a 3,3590/3,3600 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) retrocedía un 0,29% a 1.565,18 puntos. * Los mercados de Brasil permanecían cerrados el lunes por la conmemoración de El Día de la Independencia.
